content: GOD WANDƗ MAA KRAIST LAATNDA VLA LAATNƗN

Ngwuk wupma ana yetɨgangwuk. Ngwuk Kraist kiyalaa laakna vak vla kiyalaa laakngwuk. Wan kɨpmana vak kat mɨna ke yelavɨka yetɨga. Ngwuk nyinangwupmba lɨga nda kat mɨna yelavɨka yetɨ ngwula. Wan kava Kraist Godna yaagindan naangamba ndaalɨgandɨ.
Wan kɨpmana nda mɨna klavat ke yelavɨka yetɨngwa. Ngwuk nyɨnangwutna nda klavak kat yelavɨkiyangwuk.
Wan kɨpmana nda mɨna yelavɨtɨngwa maawut ndɨ tamba ngɨlɨndɨ. Mbambala Godnagwi Kraistnonala kɨta vat kupi maawupmba yetɨgangwuk. Tɨga lɨga wan tamba la kavle vat ngwuk kat ana kwulakiyandɨ.
Kɨta vat yetɨlɨna nyan Kraist yandɨ mala kɨta vat yetɨgiyanɨn. Apma vat yetɨnda vak klalaa yetɨnda vla yetɨgiyanɨn.

Ngwutna maawupmba lɨga vat wan kɨpmana vapmba yetɨ ngwula waa walɨga vak kat vatnya ngwula. Kɨngi kavle vak kat kai waa walɨgowun. Yambɨsɨk yiga yetɨnja vak, kavle vak yetɨvak kat walɨnja vak, sɨkwuka yetɨlɨnja vak, nat nɨmbana nɨma sakwat nda kat klavak kat woviyaguga yetɨlɨnja vak. Nat nɨmbana nda kat klavak kat yelavɨtɨnja vak waagan kwunatɨnja vak vla lɨgandɨ. Kavle vak mbɨt.
Wan kavle vapmba yetɨlɨga nɨmba kat God kɨmbut yiga ndi kat sɨgiyandɨ. Ndɨnai waa nyaangɨt wupmak kat kai walɨgandi.
Ngwutno tak wungi vat kavle vat yilɨngwuk. Tak wungi vat kavle vat ngwuk kat kwutaa vɨga lɨndɨ.
Wan vak mbambala aywaa kwagala ngwula. Nat nyan kat njɨka nat nyan kat kimbut yiga ke yetɨga. Nat nyan kat kavle vat yiga ndɨna sɨ kat ke viyesandaga. Kavle nyaangɨt ke mbuka.
Nat nɨmba kat ngwutna maawupmba ke woseka waa. Wan tamba yelavɨka yetɨngwa maawut tamba kwagalangwuk. Tambana maawut wala vapmba manda kat yetɨgiyangwuk.

Mbambala kupi maawut klalaa mandɨp vapmba yetɨgiyangwuk. Wan kupi maawut God kwukna maawutna. Nandinya nandinya kwunatɨgandɨ wungi kupi maawuk kat. God ndɨnai yeta vapmba yetɨngwangat ngwutna kupi maawut kwunatɨgandɨ. Wungi kupi maawupmba God kat yelavɨka yetɨngwangat kwunatɨgandɨ.

Kraistnonala kɨta mbaapmamba kɨta vat tɨganɨn. Juda ana ndi Juda ndi waa ana kapma kapma kalɨkiyandi. Mbangɨ pɨtnja nɨmba ndi mbangɨ pɨtapman nɨmba ndi waa ana kapma kapma kalɨkiyandi. Nambuo lɨga nɨmba ndi nambu lapman tɨga nɨmba ndi wa ana kapma kapma kalɨkiyandi. Njɨvwa kwutaa nɨmba ndi kwo nat nɨmba kat vɨga la nɨmba ndi waa ana kapma kapma kalɨkiyandi. Kraistnonala nɨn aywaa kɨta vat tɨganɨn. Wan mbaapma nɨmbana maawupmba aywaa ndina maawupmba Kraist yetɨlɨgandɨ.
NAT NƗMBA KAT APMA VAT YETƗNA VAT

Ngwuk aywaa Godna apma nɨmba ngwuk. Ngwuk kat woviyaguga lɨga ngwuk aywaa wuna nɨmbat tɨgiyangwuk waa wandɨ God. Yagwa ngwula aywaa waa wandɨ God. Ngivak kat tɨga nat nɨmba kat yelavɨka apma vat ay ngwula. Nat nyan ngwuk kat njɨtndeyan awat ke ndɨ kat njɨka. Njɨtnda vak kat ke yelavɨkngweya. Njambwi nayan kat njɨkngwa vat yelavɨtapman yinda vak vla nat nɨmba kat ke yelavɨkngwa.
Wundi apma vapmba yetɨga ngwuk awat sowat woviyaguga alɨ ngwula. Nat nɨmba kat woviyaguga lɨngweyan wan apma vatna angwa vatna.

Kraist ngwutna maawupmba taaganda apma vapmba yetɨ ngwula. Wan apma vapmba yetɨngwangat wuna mbaapmat aywaa yagwa ngwula waa wandɨ God. Tɨga lɨga ngwutna maawupmba tɨgandɨ. Wan apma nyaangɨt awat sowat yigumba mbuka vɨsɨmogwiga apma vat alɨ ngwula. Godna sɨ kwusoga God waa nyaangɨt tɨga mbangu kwundi waga alɨ ngwula. God kat sɨvu kɨga mbangu kwundi waga alɨ ngwula.
Kwutɨngwa njɨvwa aywaa njambwi nyan Jisasna sɨmba agwuk ngwula. Walɨngwa nyaangɨt aywaa ndɨna sɨmba waga awa ngwula. Jisasna sɨmba waga nɨna nyaek God kat sɨvu agɨ ngwula.
DU, TAAGWA, NYANGUNA NYAANGƗT
Ngwuk taagwa ngwutna lana kwupmba lɨga ndɨna kwundi wuka yetɨ ngwula. God wungi vak kat woviyaguga lɨgandɨ.
Ngwut ndu ngwutna taagwa kat yigumba kwunaka nɨma maawut yelavɨka alɨ ngwula. Ndi kat ke nɨma vat yiga njɨka.
Ngwut mat nyangu nyaek nyɨmena kwundi wuka yetɨ ngwula. God wungi vak kat woviyaguga lɨgandɨ.
Ngwuk nyaek nyɨme sɨva sɨva nyangu kat nɨma vat yingweyan ndina maawut kavle yiga tɨpmwigwula yigiyandi.
NJƗVWA KWUTA NƗMBO NAT NJƗVWA KAT VƗGA LA NYANA NYAANGƗT

Ngwuk kontrakna nɨmba ngwutna njambwi nyana kwundimba wuka njɨvwa agwuk ngwula. Ngwuk kat yiga vɨndeya njɨmbla mɨna ndɨna kwundimba njɨvwa kwukngweyan ana nglaatndɨ. Njɨmbal njɨmbla ndɨna kwundi wuka yigumba alɨ ngwula. God njɨmbla njɨmbla nɨnai kwutaa njɨvwa vɨga lɨgandɨ waa yelavɨk ngwula. Ngi vak kat tɨga apma vat njɨvwa kwukiyanɨn.
Kwutɨngweya njɨvwa aywaa nɨmbamba agwuk ngwula. maawupmba yelavɨk ngwula. Wan kwutuwa njɨvwa ndinyangu kat ana kwutɨgowun. God kat kwutɨgowun waa yelavɨk ngwula.
God ngwuk kat wenga kwigiyandɨ. Ndɨna nyangu kat kwivat taakanda nda ngwuk kat kwiga tɨgandɨ. kwutɨngwa njɨvwana njambwi nyan ndu nyan ana ndɨ. Njambwi nyan Kraistna.
Kɨta nyan kavle njɨvwa kwutndeyan God ndɨ kat kavle wenga kwigiyandɨ. God nat ana woseka waiganɨn.
